_help: Copy to config/cli-profiles.json and edit locally. This is trusted administrator configuration, never model-generated input. Profiles override built-ins by id. Prompt goes to stdin; {model} is the only argument placeholder. Use native .exe on Windows; .cmd/.bat/.ps1 are deliberately unsupported. For a JavaScript CLI use node.exe as command and an absolute JS entry point in args. Custom tools must be configured for text-only output and restricted capabilities by their operator. Never place API keys here; envAllowList contains variable names only.

profiles.name: 自定义本机 JSON CLI（配置后启用）
